w: This morning, the murti of Harikrishna Maharaj was honored by the devotees of Navsari.
Offering Prostrations

Swamishri arrived in Gadhada at 10.40 a.m. On visiting the holy places of Shriji Maharaj, Swamishri performed prostrations at several places. In the evening the sadhus, on informing Swamishri that he had performed 36 prostrations in the morning, requested that because of old age and failing health he should not prostrate at all the holy places. Swamishri replied, "One should offer prostrations. And besides, we have come here after eight to ten months. If it is a daily routine then you are right. And I had not prostrated at all the places. I had prostrated only at the main places - the mandir, Akshar Ordi, Laxmi Vadi - and while doing darshan at the other places I got enough rest. The sadhus respectfully added, "But if we were to do it on your behalf !" Swamishri replied, "Only by eating can one fulfill one's hunger. If I eat, will it satisfy your hunger? Likewise, the prostrations have to be done by myself." Even at the age of 80 Swamishri pays no attention to old age when it comes to offering reverence, and respect to Lord Swaminarayan and the holy places.

After blessing a small gathering in Ajman Swamishri traveled to Sharjah. In his discourse to the devotees of Ajman, Swamishri said, "Satsang means satpurush. Such devotion is possible only through the association of a satpurush. We pray to God to bless you with happiness in this world and the world hereafter."

The evening assembly was arranged at an industrial estate in Sharjah. A colorful welcome dance was performed by children and after a few discourses Swamishri blessed the assembly, "Through business and worldly talks one acquires happiness for this body. But to attain peace in one's atma, one needs to talk about God. One cannot satisfy one's hunger by placing a plate of gold or jewelry. It is our experience that hunger can only be satisfied through food and thirst through water. Likewise for peace of mind and atma one requires spiritual discourses, and talks related to God and dharma. "

This morning, 500 devotees from the age of seven to eighty-two pilgrimaged by foot from Botad to Sarangpur. Many devotees from the villages of Gadhada, Sangavadar, etc. Swamishri blessed all the devotees.
Swamishri performed pujan of bricks for the foundation-stone laying ceremony of another mandir (sanskardham) in Botad.

After yesterday's yagna in which 93 couples participated around 29 yagna pits, the pratishtha ceremony was held this morning. Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha ceremony of Shri Akshar Purushottam Maharaj and Guru Parampara at the hari mandir in Raliyana village. Thereafter Swamishri blessed the murti-pratishtha assembly in which 5,000 devotees and wellwishers were present. Thereafter Swamishri returned to Gadhada.
In the evening assembly, corporators of Gadhada Municipality honored Swamishri with bouquets and received his blessings. In conclusion Swamishri addressed the assembly.
At 10.50 a.m. Swamishri arrived at the BAPS Swaminarayan Mandir (hari-mandir) in the suburb of Malvani. Swamishri performed the pujan and arti and blessed the assembly.
At 12.10 p.m. Swamishri arrived at the BAPS Swaminarayan Mandir (hari-mandir) in the suburb of Miraroad. After performing pujan and arti Swamishri blessed the assembly.
At 5.45 p.m. Swamishri arrived at the BAPS Swaminarayan Mandir (hari-mandir) in the suburb of Vasai. After performing pujan and arti rituals Swamishri blessed the assembly.

Pramukh Swami Maharaj, seated in a golf cart, was going for darshan. On the way to the Smruti Mandir, Vinay had sung the couplet "Nane se ho nana rahie..." (Be small, remain small). Swamishri had asked him, "What is its meaning?"
He had answered, "To remain humble. To offer devotion as a servant."
After darshan, while going back to the residence, Vinay took up the thread again. He said to Swamishri, "You spoke of remaining small, but many times when we are small we get beaten a lot."
Swamishri said, "Gold is shaped only when it is hammered. Iron too has to be hammered to be shaped, and only then does it have value. How much Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj also endured!"
"Bapa! Let me be beaten too," Vinay requested.

Swamishri said, "Whatever happens by God's will, bear it. Otherwise, if God and the Sant made you suffer blows, your mind would again feel hurt." By giving a special meaning to being beaten, Swamishri taught the seeker the lesson of spiritual practice: to bend the mind.

An elderly devotee had come from Africa. His wife had passed away. Weeping before Pramukh Swami Maharaj, he said, "I have become alone..."

Swamishri immediately said, "We are not alone at all. God and the Sant are always with us. All these sadhus are with us. Keep going to the mandir. Keep doing seva and devotion, and there will be no problem."

A one-day shibir was held for devotees of the Sarangpur region. Swamishri blessed the shibir participants after his morning puja. He explained about how to attain peace of mind, “Because of I-ness and Mine-ness we get embroiled in conflicts and experience misery. To overcome them one should engage in listening to spiritual discourses and doing bhajan and kirtan.”

9 April 2009, (V.S. 2065, Akshar Purnima Hanumanjayanti) Thusday, Sarangpur Swamishri performed arti and mantra pushpanjali rituals to commemorate the patotsav of Yagnapurush Smruti Mandir. During his puja the diksha ceremony for 31 parshads and 16 sadhaks was conducted. Finally the senior sadhus gave each a new kanthi, upper cloth, pagh , smeared chandan on their forehead, and gave a certificate of Swamishri’s blessings and prasad to each parent. Swamishri gave the guru mantra to each of the newly initiated youth. In his blessings Swamishri praised the parents for their sacrifice and devotion and inspired the newly initiated sadhus and parshads that they had married God and henceforth their duty was to engage in service, devotion and listening to discourses.

C. L. Patel, chairman of the Charutar Vidyamandal, had come for darshan. In particular, by founding modern educational institutions he had improved the brand image of the whole of S. P. University (Vidyanagar). He had taken up this position only on Pramukh Swami Maharaj's instruction. So today too, expressing his gratitude, he said, "Whatever there is, is only because of you. At present projects worth 600 crore rupees are running. It is only from you that we get strength, otherwise one would wonder how so much could be done. But with your blessings everything keeps getting completed. I am only doing my duty here as a soldier of BAPS, and please bless us that we can work in the same way."
Swamishri said, "You have proved yourself by founding new colleges and doing the work, so people trust you too, and that is why they donate."

C. L. Patel said, "Please bless me that I can serve for as long as you wish. I firmly believe that whatever there is, is because of you, and I work only as a soldier in the work that the BAPS Sanstha has taken up for education."

Today, in a telephone conversation with Pramukh Swami Maharaj, the former Chief Minister of Gujarat, Madhavsinh Solanki, said, "We remember you. We remembered you before too. You could not come for the inauguration of the show. I pray to God that you stay on this earth for another fifty years and give everyone happiness and peace."
Swamishri said, "It is your good feeling. You have done much seva, so we pray that your health stays good and that you find happiness and peace."

The phone conversation with Swamishri ended. Afterwards, talking with the sadhus, he said, "Once I went to Pramukh Swami Maharaj and sat with him for fifteen minutes. Pramukh Swami Maharaj did not speak a single sentence, but I still remember today the divinity and peace I experienced at that time."

Today's walk turned into a "yoga of laughter". Recently, a national conference on yoga had been held at the BAPS mandir in Shahibaug, Ahmedabad, jointly organised by the AARSH research centre of the BAPS Swaminarayan Sanstha and Somnath Sanskrit University. Shrutiprakash Swami was showing Pramukh Swami Maharaj an edited video of this conference. However, because of a technical fault the video kept freezing again and again. Each time it froze and had to be fast forwarded, it started again from the beginning. So no sooner had a scene finished, or not quite finished, than it started all over again. This went on right until the end of the walk, and Swamishri kept responding with hearty laughter. A scene would be playing and it would freeze. Watching Shrutiprakash Swami struggling to fix it, Swamishri kept giving all kinds of names of yoga. Sometimes "muddle yoga", sometimes "mix-up yoga", sometimes "beginner's yoga", sometimes "laughter yoga", and as he gave these names Swamishri too laughed heartily. Sometimes, even without watching a video programme, Swamishri enters everyone's heart, and today everyone who had come for darshan witnessed this directly. In the end the video never did finish, so, laughing as he went to his bed, he said, "There, this too is a yoga." Saying this, Swamishri went into yoga-nidra (sleep).
Today Swamishri was to have his EECP treatment. So at 5:55 Yogicharan Swami came and said to Dharmacharan Swami, "There are only five minutes left now, then Swamishri has to get up."

Pramukh Swami Maharaj was writing letters. Even after Yogicharan Swami came back five minutes later, Swamishri went on writing letters. Narayancharan Swami came to help Swamishri stand up and took away the rostrum in front of him, but Swamishri still said, "How many letters are still left?"
Dharmacharan Swami said, "About five are left. It will be fine if you sign them later."
Swamishri said, "Bring them!" Saying this, he carried on signing. After signing about five letters, Swamishri stood up.
